description.zh: 流名称，格式为AppName/StreamName, 多个用,隔开
description.en: The name of the stream in the AppName/StreamName format. To specify multiple streams, separate the stream names with commas.

description.zh: 用于指定主播推流还是客户端拉流, 目前支持“publisher”（主播推送）
description.en: The type of live stream. Only publisher is supported, which indicates that the stream is ingested by a streamer.

title.zh: 批量恢复某条监控流的推送
title.en: Batch resume the push of a monitoring stream.
